query:
SELECT DISTINCT formaCobranca, estado, COUNT(*) as cnt
FROM accounts_receivable 
WHERE formaCobranca LIKE '%Cheque%' OR formaCobranca LIKE '%Boleto%'
GROUP BY formaCobranca, estado
ORDER BY formaCobranca, estado;
